ui.printstage.title: Hlela izinto ebhedini lephrinta yakho bese uzithumela kuphrintha
ps.title: Isigaba sokuphrinta
ps.lab: Okusha kulokhu kwakhiwo. Qaphela okuphrintwa kuqala: lesi sihlukanisi asikazami kumaphrinta amaningi.
ps.add.nobody: Lesi sinto asinaso isimo se-3D sokuphrinta.
ps.stage.empty: Akukho lutho lapha okwamanje. Engeza okuthile kuMtapo, noma udwebe noma ulethe imodeli: konke okubonakala ekubukweni kuzophrintwa.
ps.stage.move: Hambisa, zungezisa nxenxa izinto ekubukweni ngamathuluzi ajwayelekile. Umugqa ophuka-phukile ungumkhawulo webhedi yakho.
ps.stage.overlap: Ezinye amabhokisi ayahlanganiswa. Lokho kulungile uma izimo zingathinti; izimo ezithintanayo ziphrintwa njengesiqephu esisodwa.
ps.arrange.left: {n} akulinganga. Zincishe noma uziphrinte ngokusebenza okunye.
ps.link.needs_studio: Le phrintha isebenza ngeCadCraft Studio ekhompyutheni. Vula lo modeli ku-Studio ukuze uwuthumele.
ps.link.slicer: Le phrintha isebenzisa i-OrcaSlicer ngezilungiselelo zayo. Impahla, izinga, ukugcwaliswa nezisekelo ngaphansi kusasebenza; amazinga okushisa avela kulungiselelo.
ps.engine.need.needs_studio: {name} iyinhlelo yayo, ngakho isebenza ngeCadCraft Studio ekhompyutheni. Khetha esinye isihlukanisi lapha, noma vula lokhu ku-Studio.
ps.tech.label: Ukuprinta nge
ps.printer.mk4: Isitayela se-Prusa MK4, 250 × 210 × 220 mm (i-G-code yayo yokuqala)
ps.field.bridges: Izikhala zobhuloho (ziphrintwa ngaphesheya, ziyahamba kancane, ifeni igcwele)
ps.preview.ready: Sikiwe: {n} izingqimba. Hambisa isilayidi ukuze ubheke kuzo ngaphambi kokuthumela.
ps.preview.canvas: Ungqimba oluqoshiwe lubonwa lusuka phezulu, phezu komkhawulo webhedi
ps.preview.stale: Isiteji noma izilungiselelo sekushintshile kusukela kwasikwa. Cindezela Bona izingqimba futhi.
ps.usb.none: Ukuphrinta nge-USB kudinga i-Chrome noma i-Edge ekhompyutheni. Iphrintha yenethiwekhi isebenza nalapha futhi.
ps.net.note: Iphrintha kufanele ivumele le sayithi. Ku-Moonraker, engeza le sayithi ku-cors_domains; ku-OctoPrint, vula i-CORS bese ukopisha ukhiye we-API. Isiphequluli sakho singacela ukufinyelela amadivayisi enethiwekhi yakho: vuma.
ps.send.check: Ibhedi icacile, nempahla efanele ifakiwe? Iphrintha izofudumala futhi iqale ukunyakaza.
ps.send.summary: Cishe {time}, {grams} g zempahla, {layers} izingqimba. Inozulu {temp} °C, ibhedi {bed} °C.
ps.send.usb_note: Nge-USB, gcina leli khasi livuliwe kuze kuphele ukuphrinta. Ukulivala kumisa ukudluliswa, nezishisi zizohlala zivuliwe kuze iphrintha ipheliswe isikhathi.
ps.warn.skipped_one: Ingxenye eyodwa ayinabo ubukhulu noma ayikwazanga ukuvalwa, ngakho izongaphezu ({share}% wesimo).
ps.warn.skipped: Izingxenye {n} azinabo ubukhulu noma azikwazanga ukuvalwa, ngakho zizongaphezu ({share}% wesimo).
ps.warn.sheets_one: Ipaneli esicaba eyodwa (ilebhuli noma umugqa wokuhlobisa) yayingenabo ubukhulu, ngakho yaphrintwa ngobukhulu bomugqa wenozulu owodwa.
ps.warn.sheets: Amapaneli {n} asicaba (amalebhuli noma imigqa yokuhlobisa) ayengenabo ubukhulu, ngakho aphrintwa ngobukhulu bomugqa wenozulu owodwa.
ps.warn.thin: Kuze kube {n}% wesendlalelo ukhulu kakhulu kulo nozulu futhi ngeke luphrintwe. Yenza likhulu, noma uqinisa lezo zingxenye.
ps.warn.overhang: Ezinye izingxenye azinalutho ngaphansi kwazo. Vula izisekelo, noma uphendulise imodeli ukuze zibe njalo.
ps.warn.floating: Imodeli ayihlali ebhedini, ngakho yehliselwe kuyo.
ps.slice.open: Akukho lutho lwalokhu oluyisimo esivaliwe, ngakho akukho okungagcwaliswa yiphrintha.
ps.slice.bed: Lokhu akulingani ebhedini. Sebenzisa Lingana konke ebhedini, noma uhambise ngaphakathi komkhawulo.
ps.fail.unreachable: Iphrintha ayiphendulanga. Hlola ikheli, ukuthi livumela le sayithi, nokuthi isiphequluli singafinyelela inethiwekhi yakho.
ps.fail.unsupported: Lesi siphequluli asikwazi ukusebenzisa amadivayisi e-USB.
ps.fail.printer: Iphrintha ibike iphutha, ngakho ukuthumela kumisiwe.
ps.pc.pick: Khetha into eyodwa kuhlu olungezansi ukuze uyiphendulise.
ps.pc.flat.title: Beka phezu kwebhedi ubuso obukhulu obucaba obungayiphatha
ps.pc.turn.title: Phendulisa ingxenye yesine yokujikeleza ebhedini
ps.pc.asdesigned.title: Yibuyisele njengoba ingxenye idwetshwe ngayo (phezulu kwayo kuphezulu)
ps.pc.flat.done: {name} ilele phezu kobuso obucaba, indawo {area} mm².
ps.pc.flat.already: {name} seyilele phezu kobuso bayo obukhulu obucaba kakade.
ps.pc.flat.none: {name} ayinabuso obucaba okuzoncika kubo. Yiphendulise ngesandla.
ps.pc.why.open: inemigoqo evulekile {n}, ngakho isikhumba sayo sinemingxunya
ps.pc.why.nonmanifold: inemigoqo {n} lapho okungaphezu kwezinhlangothi ezintathu zihlangana
ps.pc.why.flipped: inezindawo {n} lapho izinhlangothi ezingomakhelwane zibheka ezindleleni eziphambene
ps.bim.note: Khetha izakhi kumbukwano we-3D, bese uzithatha. Zilele ebhedini njengezikhopi, ngezindawo zazo njengoba zidwetshwe. Ukuhambisa, ukuphendulisa nokuncishisa lapha kushintsha ukuhlelwa kokuphrinta kuphela, hhayi imodeli.
ps.bim.take.sel.title: Beka ebhedini izakhi ezikhethwe kumbukwano we-3D
ps.bim.take.shown.title: Beka ebhedini zonke izakhi ezibonisiwe kumbukwano we-3D (inani eliphezulu lika-300)
ps.bim.none.sel: Akukho okukhethiwe kumbukwano we-3D. Khetha izakhi, bese uzithatha futhi.
ps.bim.left: {name} ushiyiwe ngaphandle kwebhedi: akuyona inqwaba evaliwe, {why}.
ps.bim.more: Ezinye izakhi {n} azithathwanga: ibhedi libamba izinto ezingama-300 kuphela. Khetha ezimbalwa.
ps.bim.scale.title: Kala konke ebhedini ngenombolo eyodwa, ukuze izilinganiso zihlale zifana
ps.bim.lifesize.title: Buyisela konke ebukhulwini bakho kumodeli (kukhulu kakhulu kumabhedi amaningi)
